## What changes for users?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any migration or setup change.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. For UI changes include desktop and mobile screenshots; for API changes cover ownership, validation, and failure behavior.

## Documentation and operational impact

Update the main README and affected guides when capabilities or workflows change. Call out new environment variables, data changes, costs, or deployment prerequisites. Keep sample data visibly labelled.
